g.text: The context window is the bandwidth: forward everything and the runtime silently drops the user's budget.
A big message costs you on every link:
· it's slow to send, and slower on a shared link
· it crowds out everything else on the way
Slow, or rejected, but never cut short.
Fix: send a reference (Claim Check), fetch the data only
where it's needed, and size messages on purpose.
over a budget it can no longer see
(1) the Research agent returns everything it read
(2) the runtime drops the oldest messages, with no error
(3) the orchestrator forwards the whole run history
Fix: a summary and a reference (reviews/trip-42), the budget
in the task, and an error if it still doesn't fit.
